data.decision: Create a new top-level component krebs/ to own the canonical ticket-lifecycle spec, ticket-provider adapters, webhook normalization/fan-out, and observability.
data.reasoning: Lifecycle state machine, provider abstraction, and webhook fan-out were scattered across momo/skill/, per-repo _bmad/custom/workflows/, and ad-hoc tp adapters. Centralizing them under krebs/ gives one SSOT (spec/lifecycle.v1.yaml), a Strategy-pattern provider layer, and Bloodbank-normalized events. Momo consumes the spec from krebs; mcp-hub will expose krebs domains.

data.decision: Commit and push 33GOD root and all submodules; leave runtime/worktree artifacts untracked
data.reasoning: Committed and pushed all outstanding changes across the 33GOD root repo and its submodules so the platform stays in sync with origin and the pipeline is unblocked. Submodule pushes required rebase/merge for bloodbank and hermes-agent-template due to upstream advancement; candybar runtime submodule was re-initialized to its recorded gitlink. Live runtime state remains untracked inside the candybar runtime submodule; bloodbank has an untracked nested worktree (.worktrees/pjan-19-hermes-gateway) that was left unstaged.
